title: Comic Strip Documentary "Stripped"
content: A feature-length documentary has been released about comic strips and how they're coping with the disappearance of newspapers. The video includes a poster by the elusive Bill Watterson (Calvin & Hobbes), along with on-camera interviews with Jim Davis (Garfield), Cathy Guisewite (Cathy), Scott McCloud (Understanding Comics), Mort Walker (Beetle Bailey)and 70 others.(Video link) Here's the trailer.
